Kanakadhvaja, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 182 (Dhṛtarāshṭraputranāmak.): I, 117, 4553.--§ 232 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 186, 6983 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī).-§ 585 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 96, 4349 (is slain by Bhīmasena).
Kanakāksha, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2576.
Kanakāṅgada, a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2740 (enumeration). Cf. Kanakadhvaja.
kanakaparvata (“the golden mountain”), said of Mahāmeru: XII, 2240.
Kanakāpīḍa, a warrior of Skanda. § 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2568.
Kanakāyu(s), a son of Dhṛtarāshṭra. § 130 (Aṃśāvat.): I, 67, 2734. Cf. Karakāyu.

Kanyāsaṃvedya, a tīrtha. § 370 (Tīrthayātrāp.): III, 84, 8114. Cf. Kanyā.
